description: Engagement snapshot of a public Instagram account: followers and the 12 newest posts with likes, comments and per-post engagement rate ((likes+comments)/followers), plus averages, median likes, best post and posting frequency over those 12. Only counts, no comment text or video views. Hidden like counts give null. Unknown users 404; a failed fetch 503 (not charged). Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_pinterest when you need latest pins of a public Pinterest profile from Pinterest's; social_snapchat when you need Public Snapchat profile from its web profile page. Price: $0.005 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
